jin_color.description: Allows the model to update the JIN runtime avatar center point color and its subtle glow for the current live session.
rules: Use to set single color for the live JIN avatar center point color and chat interface background tint.
Emit marker using exactly this schema <JIN_COLOR: #00f2ff >
Emit several markers in one message for consecutive color change or blinking effect, last color in sequence will be used as current.
The payload must be a hex color with optional leading # and exactly 3 or 6 hex characters.
